app_description: Izifundo zamarobhothi ne-STEM zamahhala zabafundi, othisha nabazali. Akha amarobhothi ngekhadibhodi, bese ufunda ukuwahlela ngekhodi.
home_intro: Akha irobhothi langempela ngekhadibhodi, izinti nenjini eyodwa encane. Bese ufunda ukulilawula ngekhodi.
home_point_offline: Isebenza ocingweni olulula, ngisho ungenayo i-inthanethi
about_mission: I-Robots For All yenza imfundo yamarobhothi ne-STEM ibe mahhala kuyo yonke ingane nomuntu omdala, noma ngabe uhola malini, ukhuluma luphi ulimi noma ufunda kusiphi isikole.
about_how_build: Akha: yenza amarobhothi anyakazayo ngekhadibhodi usebenzisa ama-crank, amagiya, izinsimbi zokuphakamisa nezixhumanisi, kuxhunywe nohlelo lwezifundo lwesikole.
about_how_control: Lawula: engeza i-micro:bit noma ibhodi elifanayo ukuze irobhothi lakho lihambe, lime futhi likhanyise.
about_how_integrate: Hlanganisa: klama amaphrojekthi aphelele amarobhothi ahlanganisa konke osukufundile.
about_who_body: Abafundi kusukela eBangeni 3 kuya phezulu, othisha, abaqeqeshi bamarobhothi, abazali, imindeni efundisela ekhaya, izikole nezikhungo zomphakathi.
privacy_intro: I-Robots For All isetshenziswa yizingane, ngakho siqoqa okuncane ngangokunokwenzeka. Nakhu ngqo okwenzekayo uma usebenzisa le sayithi.
privacy_collect_none: Lutho ngawe. Awekho ama-akhawunti, awekho amafomu okubhalisa futhi awekho ama-cookie.
privacy_collect_no_tracking: Azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelelwa futhi akukho ukuhlaziywa. Asilayishi lutho kwamanye amawebhusayithi.
privacy_collect_hosting: Umhlinzeki wethu wokusingatha (Cloudflare) uletha amakhasi futhi angagcina amarekhodi ayisisekelo obuchwepheshe, njengamakheli e-IP, isikhashana ukuze kuvikeleke isayithi. Asiwasebenzisi lawa marekhodi ukuhlonza muntu.
privacy_device_body: Ukuze isebenze ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, le sayithi igcina amakhasi ayo, nezifundo ozilandayo, endaweni yokugcina yesiphequluli ocingweni lwakho. Lokhu akuphumi neze ocingweni lwakho.
privacy_device_remove: Ukukususa, sula idatha yale sayithi kuzilungiselelo zesiphequluli sakho.
privacy_children_body: Izingane zingasebenzisa zonke izifundo zinganikezanga lutho lomuntu siqu. Uma singeza ama-akhawunti kamuva, umzali, umnakekeli noma uthisha uzowasetha, futhi sizobuyekeza leli khasi kuqala.
privacy_changes_body: Uma kukhona okushintshayo lapha, sizobuyekeza leli khasi ngaphambi kokuba ushintsho lwenzeke.
lessons_intro: Izifundo zamarobhothi ozenza ngezandla usebenzisa izinto ezishibhile nezisetshenziswe kabusha. Isifundo ngasinye silandela izinyathelo ezinhlanu: Bikezela, Qalisa, Phenya, Shintsha futhi Wenze.
lesson_adult_help: Umuntu omdala kumele asize kwezinye izinyathelo.
template_print_hint: Phrinta ku-A4 ngo-100% ("Actual size"), hhayi "Fit to page". Bese uhlola ukuthi isikwele esiphepheni silinganisa u-50 mm. Awunayo iphrinta? Sebenzisa izilinganiso ezingezansi ukudweba izingxenye ngerula.
template_check_square: Phrinta ngo-100% (Actual size). Lesi sikwele kumele silinganise u-50 mm; uma kungenjalo, shintsha izilungiselelo zakho zokuphrinta.
template_key: Sika emigqeni eqinile. Goqa emigqeni enamachashazi. Bhoboza izimbobo lapho ubona khona isiphambano.
slides_hint: Swayipha noma usebenzise okhiye bemicibisholo ukuhamba phakathi kwamasilayidi.
footer_promise: Azikho izikhangiso. Akukho ukulandelelwa. Mahhala kuwo wonke umuntu.
footer_licence: Ikhodi: ilayisensi ye-MIT. Izifundo: CC BY-SA 4.0.
notfound_body: Asikwazanga ukulithola lelo khasi. Kungenzeka ukuthi lithuthiwe.
lesson_save_failed: Asikwazanga ukugcina lesi sifundo. Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho bese uzama futhi.
lesson_download_hint: Igcina lesi sifundo kulolu cingo ukuze ukwazi ukusisebenzisa ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
offline_body: Leli khasi alikagcinwa kulolu cingo. Amakhasi owavule ngaphambilini asasebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
update_available: Inguqulo entsha ye-Robots For All isilungile.
code_intro: Hlanganisa amabhulokhi ukuze wenze uhlelo. Luzame esikrinini, bese ulithumela ku-micro:bit.
code_failed: Lokho akusebenzanga. Hlola ukuthi i-micro:bit ixhunyiwe bese uzama futhi, noma usebenzise u-Landa i-.hex.
code_no_usb: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukuthumela ngqo ku-micro:bit. Sebenzisa u-Landa i-.hex, bese ukopisha ifayela uliyise ku-drive ethi MICROBIT.
block_forever_tip: Isebenza kaningi kaningi, inqobo nje uma i-micro:bit ivuliwe.
block_random: khetha noma iyiphi kusukela ku-%1 kuya ku-%2
block_motor_tip: Ishayela injini yerobhothi: erobhothini elinenjini eyodwa ishayela kokubili amasondo, erobhothini elinezinjini ezimbili ishayela ekwesobunxele.
code_variable_invalid: Sebenzisa izinhlamvu, izinombolo nezikhala kuphela (kuze kufike ku-30).
code_saved_here: Izinhlelo zigcinwa kule divayisi kuphela. Noma ubani osebenzisa lesi siphequluli angazibona.
code_import_failed: Lelo fayela akulona uhlelo lwe-Robots For All.
code_python_intro: Le yi-MicroPython eyenziwa amabhulokhi akho. Yiyo esebenza ku-micro:bit.
code_edit_python_confirm: Shintshela lolu hlelo ekuthayipheni i-Python? Ungaqhubeka ulushintsha njenge-Python, kodwa izinguquko ngeke ziphinde zibe amabhulokhi.
code_back_to_blocks_confirm: Sebenzisa amabhulokhi akho futhi? I-micro:bit esesikrinini no-Landa bazosebenzisa amabhulokhi. I-Python oyithayiphile igcinwa njengohlelo oluhlukile ku-Izinhlelo zami.
code_python_mode_note: Lolu hlelo lusebenzisa i-Python ethayiphiwe. Thepha u-Amabhulokhi ukuze usebenzise amabhulokhi akho futhi.
code_python_keys: U-Tab ungeza ukuhlehlisa. Ukuphuma ebhokisini lekhodi ngekhibhodi, cindezela u-Esc, bese u-Tab.
block_random_bool: khetha noma yikuphi, iqiniso noma amanga
needs_new_microbit: Idinga i-micro:bit V2, entsha enesipikha nemakrofoni.
code_downloaded: ✓ Kulandiwe. Manje kopisha ifayela uliyise ku-drive ethi MICROBIT.
block_animate: bonisa opopayi %1 %2 njalo emva kwama-ms angu-%3
code_clear_python_confirm: Sula yonke i-Python ethayiphiwe bese uqala phansi?
code_python_copy_name: I-Python yakho ethayiphiwe izogcinwa njengohlelo lwayo. Kufanele ibizwe ngokuthini?
code_name_taken: Usunalo kakade uhlelo olunalelo gama. Sicela ukhethe elinye igama.
lesson_code_no_hardware: Udinga kuphela i-micro:bit esesikrinini esihlelini sekhodi.
lesson_code_microbit: Zama kuqala ku-micro:bit esesikrinini, bese ulithumela ku-micro:bit yangempela uma unayo.
lesson_code_microbit_motor: Zama kuqala ku-micro:bit esesikrinini. Ukuze irobhothi langempela lihambe udinga i-micro:bit, ibhodi lokushayela injini nephakethe lamabhethri lenjini.
sim_sound_tested: Kufanele uzwe ukukhala okufushane. Uma kungenjalo, khulisa ivolumu bese uhlola ukuthi le thebhu ayithulisiwe.
sim_sound_off: Umsindo ucishiwe. Thepha u-Hlola umsindo ukuze uwuvule.
sheet_members: Amalungu eqembu (amagama okuqala noma amagama okudlala)
sheet_make_box: Esikwenzile, ukuthi sikuhlole kanjani, nento eyodwa esiyithuthukisile:
sheet_keep: Gcina leli shidi: uthisha wakho ulisebenzisa ukubhala inqubekela phambili yakho.
block_drive_tip: Ishayela injini yesobunxele noma yesokudla, isivinini kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-100. Ibhodi lerobhothi lakho lenza ukuxhumanisa kwezintambo (Irobhothi lami).
code_extension_motordriver: Irobhothi: izinjini ezimbili ezinesivinini, izindebe, izinzwa zomugqa nepeni
world_open_floor_challenge: Ukushayela ngokukhululeka. Zama ukushayela isikwele bese ubuyela lapho uqale khona.
world_dark_tunnel_challenge: Shayela ungene emhubheni omnyama bese ume ngaphakathi kwawo.
world_box_and_back_challenge: Shayela uye phambili ungene ebhokisini, yima, bese uhlehlela emuva ekhaya ume lapho.
world_follow_the_line_challenge: Landela umugqa omnyama kuze kube sekupheleni.
world_simple_maze_challenge: Thola indlela yokuphuma. Uma ushayisa udonga, hlehla bese ujika.
world_grid_delivery_challenge: Hambisa imbewu engadini e-B3 ungashayeli udabule echibini, bese ubuyela epulazini.
world_line_junction_challenge: Landela umugqa, yima ngaphakathi emhubheni, bese uthatha igatsha eliya esibayeni.
world_bump_maze_challenge: Phunyuka emzileni oxakile. Othinta izindonga kancane uyawina.
world_line_maze_challenge: Landela imigqa uze ufike ekugcineni. Isikhathi esishesha kakhulu siyawina.
world_rhino_patrol_challenge: Ukuqapha Obhejane: qapha ucingo, dlula ehlathini elimnyama, hlola umthombo, vula isango bese ubuyela esiteshini sabaqaphi.
world_rhino_patrol_junior_challenge: Ukuqapha Obhejane Abancane: shayela udlule ehlathini elimnyama, yima emthonjeni, vakashela indawo yokubheka bese ubuyela esiteshini sabaqaphi.
world_rhino_patrol_senior_challenge: Ukuqapha Obhejane Abadala: qapha ucingo udlule ezigxotsheni ezintathu ngokulandelana, dlula ehlathini elimnyama, vula isango, hlola umthombo ongemuva kwezindonga zawo bese ubuyela esiteshini sabaqaphi.
mission_rhino_patrol_patrol: Qapha ucingo: isigxobo sasenyakatho, bese kuba esasempumalanga
mission_rhino_patrol_senior_patrol: Qapha ucingo: isigxobo sasempumalanga, esasenyakatho, bese kuba esasentshonalanga
robot_basic_two_motor_name: Imojuli eyisisekelo yezinjini ezimbili (L9110S) enezikhonkwane zengwenya
block_whisker_tip: Kuyiqiniso uma lezi zindebe zithinta okuthile.
block_line_tip: Kuyiqiniso uma le nzwa yomugqa iphezu komugqa omnyama.
block_pen_tip: Yehlisa ipeni ukuze kudwetshwe, noma uliphakamise.
season_rhino_patrol_about: Vikela obhejane: qapha ucingo, hlola umthombo bese ubuyela esiteshini sabaqaphi. Umzila owodwa weqembu ngalinye lamabanga.
world_grid_map_challenge: Shayela kusukela ku-A1 uye esikweleni C4 bese ume lapho. Hlela ukunyakaza kwakho kugridi kuqala: isikwele ngasinye singu-200 mm.
world_art_floor_challenge: Yehlisa ipeni bese udweba isikwele, unxantathu noma uhlamvu lokuqala lwegama lakho.
sim_print_actual_size: Phrinta ngo-100 % (usayizi wangempela), hhayi "fit to page".
sim_print_calibration: Lesi sikwele kumele silinganise u-100 mm ohlangothini ngalunye.
sim_print_build_sheet: Ishidi lokwakha: izingcezu zekhadibhodi nalapho ziya khona
sim_print_no_printer: Awunayo iphrinta? Dweba igridi phansi ngoshoki noma ngetheyiphu: izikwele ezingu-200 mm.
lesson_withdrawn_notice: Kuhoxisiwe: lesi sifundo asikho kusayithi ebukhoma okwamanje.
lesson_in_english_notice: Lesi sifundo asikahunyushwa, ngakho siboniswa ngesiNgisi.
lesson_translation_stale_notice: Isifundo sesiNgisi sishintshile kusukela kwahunyushwa lokhu. Kudinga ukuhlolwa futhi.

account_intro: Eyothisha, abaqeqeshi nabazali. Abafundi abayidingi i-akhawunti ukuze basebenzise izifundo, amaphethini noma isihleli sekhodi.
account_closed: Ama-akhawunti awakavulwa. Konke okunye kusayithi kusebenza ngaphandle kwayo.
account_display_name: Igama lakho njengoba abanye beribona (isibonelo uNkk Dlamini)
account_error: Lokho akusebenzanga. Hlola okuthayiphile bese uzama futhi.
account_privacy: Sisebenzisa ikheli lakho le-imeyili kuphela ukuze ungene.
account_orgs_none: Awukabi yingxenye yesikole noma yekilabhu. Bhalisa esakho ngezansi, noma ucele umphathi wayo ukuthi akungeze.
account_org_waiting: Kulindwe ukuqinisekiswa: ikilasi elilodwa lokuzama elinabafundi abangafika ku-40 kuze kube yilapho
account_org_registered_ok: Kubhalisiwe. Sizokuhlola ngemininingwane esemthethweni. Ungenza ikilasi elilodwa lokuzama manje.
account_org_emis_needed: Inombolo ye-EMIS yesikole inezinombolo ezi-6 kuya kweziyi-12.
account_org_register_needed: Thayipha inombolo yokubhalisa, noma ususe uphawu ku-“ibhalisiwe”.
account_class_share_text: Bhalisa ingane yakho ekilasini lethu le-Robots For All
account_class_qr: Ikhodi ye-QR yesixhumanisi sokubhalisa, yokuphrinta esaziso
account_class_end_confirm: Qeda leli kilasi? Izixhumanisi nokubhalisa kwalo kuyasuswa. Abafundi bagcina amabheji namarekhodi abo.
enrol_soon: Ukubhalisa kuzovulwa maduze. Uma sekuvuliwe, lesi sixhumanisi sizokuvumela ukuthi ubhalise ingane yakho ekilasini layo futhi ukhethe esikugcinayo ngayo.
account_staff_link_note: Thumela lesi sixhumanisi kozakwenu (nge-WhatsApp noma nge-imeyili). Sisebenza kanye, izinsuku eziyi-7. Bayangena bese bejoyina.
account_staff_share_text: Joyina nathi ku-Robots For All njengomsebenzi wa
account_staff_remove_confirm: Susa lo muntu esikoleni noma ekilabhini yakho? Uzolahlekelwa ukufinyelela emakilasini ayo.
account_staff_joined: Usujoyinile. Isikole noma ikilabhu manje isohlwini lwakho.
enrol_bad_link: Lesi sixhumanisi sokubhalisa asiphelele. Cela uthisha noma umqeqeshi wengane yakho ukuthi asithumele futhi.
enrol_sign_in_first: Okokuqala, ngena ngekheli lakho le-imeyili. Sikuthumelela ikhodi; awudingi iphasiwedi.
enrol_notice_kept: Sigcina kuphela igama lokudlala, ibanga, isithombe abasikhethayo, ulimi lwabo, amarekhodi ezifundo zabo namabheji abo.
enrol_notice_not_kept: Asilokothi sigcine isithombe sengane yakho, inombolo kamazisi, usuku lokuzalwa, ikheli noma inombolo yocingo, futhi akukho lutho ngabo oluthunyelwa kunoma iyiphi i-AI.
enrol_notice_who: Nguwe kuphela, nothisha noma abaqeqeshi bamakilasi owakhethayo, abangabona amarekhodi engane yakho. Akekho ongathumela umlayezo enganeni yakho.
enrol_notice_why: Ukuze ingane yakho ibhale ukufunda kwayo, ithole amabheji nezitifiketi, nothisha wayo abone inqubekela phambili yayo.
enrol_notice_withdraw: Ungashintsha noma uhoxise imvume yakho noma nini ku-akhawunti yakho. Ukuhoxisa kususa amarekhodi engane yakho.
enrol_nickname_hint: Igama lokuqala nohlamvu (isibonelo Thandi R) noma igama elimnandi. Hhayi igama labo eliphelele.
enrol_nickname_length: Igama lokudlala linezinhlamvu ezi-2 kuya kwezingama-20.
enrol_nickname_not_full_name: Lokho kubukeka njengegama eliphelele. Sicela usebenzise igama lokuqala nohlamvu, noma igama elimnandi.
enrol_consent_guardian: Ngingumzali noma umnakekeli osemthethweni wale ngane.
enrol_consent_record: Gcina amarekhodi ezifundo namabheji engane yami, njengoba kuchazwe ngenhla.
enrol_consent_class: Vumela othisha noma abaqeqeshi baleli kilasi ukuthi babone igama lokudlala nenqubekela phambili yengane yami.
enrol_name_later: Izitifiketi zingaba negama lengane yakho. Ungalengeza kamuva ku-akhawunti yakho; ligcinwa libethelwe futhi liphrintwa kuphela ezitifiketini.
enrol_done_next: Ingane yakho ingena esikoleni ngekhodi yekilasi, igama layo lokudlala ne-PIN yesithombe. Ungabona inqubekela phambili yayo futhi ushintshe imvume yakho ku-akhawunti yakho.
